narrative.overview: This records the implemented slate and teal application, not a newly approved aesthetic direction. The interface supports operating on data: begin with sample QC, then arrange candidate and protein evidence views around a research question. White surfaces, restrained borders and compact controls keep the analytical content central.
keyCharacteristics: Shared sample selection, candidate filters and focused protein across views.
Adjustable, non-overlapping analysis panels with visible alternatives to dragging.
Explicit data identity, unavailable evidence and pending analysis states.
dos: Do preserve the incumbent slate/teal shell and the analytical meaning of existing plots.
Do provide Add, keyboard and Layout-menu paths alongside pointer gestures.
Do keep layout persistence separate from sample selection, candidate filtering and protein focus.
Do show data source, pending analysis and missing evidence in text.
donts: Don't present imported statistics as newly recomputed after a filter or layout change.
Don't present the GO placeholder as completed enrichment or mix synthetic/uploaded evidence into the real snapshot.
Don't introduce overlapping panels or discard desktop geometry when the narrow layout stacks.
